decision_scope: admission for an initial pipeline pilot with known simulated optics only

model_discrepancy_comparison.left: frozen R124 2x acquisition applied to stored 2x latent target
model_discrepancy_comparison.right: independent 4x physical rendering followed by native area integration
model_discrepancy_comparison.region: both views, native supervised core rows 256:384 and columns 256:384
model_discrepancy_comparison.interpretation: RMS screen allows at most 6.25 percent additional mean-square discrepancy relative to declared noise variance; p99 protects localized mismatch. These are engineering screens, not a physics theorem.
model_discrepancy_comparison.on_breach: stop admission recommendation, preserve failure, inspect physical cause; do not fit evaluation answers or increase thresholds

structural_gates.motion_order: continuous geometry and texture translated before optics, native integration, noise, quantization

limitations: Passing this screen admits only a bounded engineering training pilot.
Known simulated PSFs are not independent calibration of real microscopy.
Real microscopy and SEM remain the primary usefulness evaluation.
Native interpolation motion checks are approximate diagnostics and cannot replace a physical-order source review.
